library.help: Reads the .txt and .md files (UTF-8 text) in the chosen folder and all its subfolders. A file NAME.txt.manifest.toml next to a text can give its title, punctuation conventions and date (era = "唐", year = 618, year_end = 907); otherwise the file name is the title. Other formats, such as Excel, are not read.

source.label: Search in
source.itkc.note: Searches ITKC's classical originals (Classical Texts and the Korean Literary Collections) online. ITKC returns excerpts of about 150 characters around the hits, cut at both ends, so results show only what the excerpt contains; the title opens the record on ITKC. The first 100 records per collection are checked. Nothing is stored.
error.itkc_alternatives: ITKC search takes one word per box, without |.
error.itkc_query: ITKC search takes words combined with AND, NOT, "phrase" or NEAR/n; OR and /regex/ are not available for ITKC.
error.source_failed: The online source did not answer. Check the connection and try again.
error.source_cap: The request limit for this session has been reached (200 requests). Restart the window to search again.
source.ndl.note: Searches the OCR text of NDL's classical books (NDL Lab). NDL finds phrases of two or more characters only, so the longer element (or the longest word) is sent and the rest is checked here. NDL returns unpunctuated OCR excerpts that may contain recognition errors, cut at both ends; check the page image through the title link before citing. The first 50 books are checked. Nothing is stored.
source.ndl.summary: NDL: {books} of {total} books found for {phrase} checked
error.ndl_short: NDL finds only phrases of two or more characters. Make at least one element two characters long, or search ITKC or your text folder.
error.ndl_alternatives: NDL is asked for one element as a phrase: at least one box must hold a single word, without |.
error.ndl_query: NDL search takes words combined with AND, NOT, "phrase" or NEAR/n; OR and /regex/ are not available for NDL.
source.cbeta.note: Searches the CBETA Buddhist canon online (CBData API). The longer element (or the longest word) is sent, and CBETA returns excerpts of 40 characters on each side of each hit; the rest is checked here. Interlinear notes are left out. The first 50 juan are checked, and the title opens the juan in CBETA Online. Texts: CBETA Chinese Electronic Tripitaka Collection, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0 (non-commercial use, attribution, share alike). Nothing is stored.
source.cbeta.summary: CBETA: {juans} of {total} juan found for {phrase} checked
error.cbeta_alternatives: CBETA is asked for one element as a phrase: at least one box must hold a single word, without |.
error.cbeta_query: CBETA search takes words combined with AND, NOT, "phrase" or NEAR/n; OR and /regex/ are not available for CBETA.

ctp.title: Import a work from the Chinese Text Project
ctp.help: CTP offers no search over its texts, so a work is imported instead: paste the address of a work or chapter on ctext.org, and its chapters are saved as .txt files (with title and source link) in a new subfolder of the open text folder, where they are searched like your other texts. CTP gives most texts only to users with an API key: get your own key from your ctext.org account and enter it here; it is stored only on this computer. CTP asks that citations link to the source page; each chapter keeps its link. Use reasonable amounts, as CTP's terms require.
ctp.key.stored: A key is stored on this computer.
ctp.key.missing: No key is stored; CTP gives very little text without one.
ctp.working: Importing… CTP is asked once a second, so a long work takes a while.
error.ctp_no_folder: Open a text folder first; the imported chapters are saved in it.
error.ctp_bad_url: This is not a ctext.org address of a work or chapter.
error.ctp_auth: CTP gives this text only with an API key. Enter your key and try again.
error.ctp_limit: CTP's request limit for your account has been reached. Try again later.
error.ctp_cap: The work is too large for one import (400 requests). Import its parts one by one.
error.ctp_empty: CTP returned no text for this address.
error.ctp_write_failed: The chapters could not be saved in the folder.

release.title: Download original texts from an institute
release.intro: Original texts that Korean institutes publish on the public data portal data.go.kr are downloaded and saved as texts you can search. Choose 1 the institute, 2 the release and 3 the folder, then press Download. The download runs in the background; the window stays usable.
release.inst.nikh.desc: Histories and registers from its Korean history database, such as 삼국사기, 고려사 and 비변사등록. Each article keeps its date and a link to the database.
release.inst.itkc: Institute for the Translation of Korean Classics
release.inst.itkc.desc: Collated and punctuated originals: collected works, miscellanies, geographies. Each piece keeps its author's years and a link to the Korean Classics database.
release.rights.kogl4: KOGL type 4: credit the source, non-commercial, no changes
release.folder.note: Each release gets its own subfolder; when it is done, this folder is opened for searching.
